text.p: Fiorentina of Italy beat Benfica of Portugal 2-0 (halftime 1-0) in their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final first leg match on Thursday.

Benfica: 1-Michel Preud'Homme, 3-Jorge Soares, 5-Jorge Bermudez, 26-El Hadrioui, 7-Jose Calado (11-Nica Panduru 44), 6-Jamir Gomes, 19-Bruno Caires (20-Illian Illiev 76), 2-Tahar Kalej, 8-Joao Pinto, 9-Hassan Nader, 18-Mauro Airez (23-Edgar Pacheco 34).

Fiorentina: 1-Francesco Toldo, 19-Pasquale Padalino, 16-Giulio Falcone, 3-Michele Serena, 14-Alessandro Cois, 5-Lorenzo Amoruso, 7-Stefan Schwarz, 11-Luis Oliveira (4-Giovanni Piacentini 46), 10-Rui Costa (23-Anselmo Robbiati 78), 9-Gabriel Batistuta, 8-Francesco Baiano (17-Vittorio Puscedou 88).
